channel.title: Version 9.5 :: Cap'n Hugo Relearrrn Theme
channel.description: 9.5.0 (2026-10-31) Enhancements [feature][change] cards: restyle th' hover o' linked cards #1380 [feature] search: board th' index only once a search be about t' happen #1373 [feature] theme: improve build performance #1372 [feature] mermaid: draw th' graphs o' th' print version one at a time #1362 [feature][change] topbar: show button titles depend'n on th' screen width #1359 [feature] image: set a default size 'n image effects #1358 Fixes [bug] a11y: let th' tab key continue from whar' was clicked #1383 [bug] a11y: make th' menu expander a click target o' its own #1382 [bug] cards: make th' rrrambl'n o' linked cards us'ble #1381 [bug] table: draw all borders 'n Firefox #1368 [bug] button: center th' ay'con without mak'n th' button taller #1366 [bug] print: put all graphs an' specs on paper 'n Firefox an' Safari #1364 [bug] print: draw Merrrmaid an' OpenAPI wit' th' colors o' th' print variant #1363 [bug] theme: make elements use letter-spac'n vari'ble as expected #1357 Maintenance [task] search: update lunr-languages t' 1.24.0 #1385 [task] theme: tidy up th' ids o' th' skip link an' th' search plank #1384 [task] theme: stop read'n reserved front matter via .Params #1377 [task] theme: prepare fer Hugo’s new template structure #1376 [task][change] mermaid: update t' 12.2.0 #1375 [task] theme: use Language.Name instead o' deprecated Language.Lang #1374 [task][change] math: deprecate delimiters 'n shortcode an' KaTeX options 'n math #1370 [task] theme: fix th' download URL o' Roboto Flex #1369 [task][change] button: deprecate iconposit'n parameter #1367 [task] print: use th' standard print-color-adjust property #1365 [task] theme: switch all layout widths by th' width classes #1361 [task] theme: adapt t' plainify changes o' Cap'n Hugo 0.169 #1360
